// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TREND ALIGNMENT RISK SCALER — Quant Prime Recoil Module
// Adjusts position size based on EMA trend alignment.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ─── INPUTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_lots     = input.float(0.01, "Base Lot Size", step=0.01, group="Risk Scaling")
with_trend_mult = input.float(2.0, "With-Trend Multiplier", step=0.5, group="Risk Scaling")
flat_mult     = input.float(1.0, "Flat/Consolidation Mult", step=0.5, group="Risk Scaling")
counter_mult  = input.float(0.5, "Counter-Trend Mult", step=0.1, group="Risk Scaling")

// EMA settings for trend detection
fast_ema_len  = input.int(8, "Fast EMA", group="Trend Detection")
slow_ema_len  = input.int(26, "Slow EMA", group="Trend Detection")
anchor_ema_len = input.int(80, "Anchor EMA", group="Trend Detection")

// ─── TREND CALCULATION ────────────────────────────────────────
ema_fast = ta.ema(close, fast_ema_len)
ema_slow = ta.ema(close, slow_ema_len)
ema_anchor = ta.ema(close, anchor_ema_len)

// Trend states
is_uptrend = ema_fast > ema_slow and ema_slow > ema_anchor
is_downtrend = ema_fast < ema_slow and ema_slow < ema_anchor
is_flat = not is_uptrend and not is_downtrend

trend_bias = is_uptrend ? 1 : is_downtrend ? -1 : 0

// ─── ALIGNMENT CALCULATION ────────────────────────────────────

    is_counter = (trade_direction == 1 and is_downtrend) or (trade_direction == -1 and is_uptrend)
    mult = is_aligned ? with_trend_mult : is_counter ? counter_mult : flat_mult
    base_lots * mult

short_lots = get_aligned_lots(-1)

products.preview:
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PARTIAL TP MANAGER — Quant Prime Recoil Module
// Framework for multi-target exits with breakeven management.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ─── INPUTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
tp1_pct      = input.float(50, "TP1 Close %", minval=10, maxval=90, group="Partial TP")
tp2_pct      = input.float(30, "TP2 Close %", minval=10, maxval=90, group="Partial TP")
move_to_be   = input.bool(true, "Move SL to BE after TP1", group="Partial TP")
be_offset    = input.float(1.0, "BE Offset (pips)", step=0.1, group="Partial TP")

tp1_rr       = input.float(1.5, "TP1 R:R", step=0.1, group="Targets")
tp2_rr       = input.float(3.0, "TP2 R:R", step=0.1, group="Targets")

// ─── STATE TRACKING ───────────────────────────────────────────
var float entry_price = na
var float sl_price = na
var float tp1_price = na
var float tp2_price = na
var bool tp1_hit = false
var bool tp2_hit = false
var int trade_direction = 0  // 1 = long, -1 = short

// ─── ENTRY FUNCTION ───────────────────────────────────────────
// Call this when you enter a trade
set_trade(float entry, float sl, int direction) =>
    entry_price := entry
    sl_price := sl
    trade_direction := direction
    risk = math.abs(entry - sl)
    tp1_price := direction == 1 ? entry + (risk * tp1_rr) : entry - (risk * tp1_rr)
    tp2_price := direction == 1 ? entry + (risk * tp2_rr) : entry - (risk * tp2_rr)
    tp1_hit := false
    tp2_hit := false

// ─── TP CHECK LOGIC ───────────────────────────────────────────
check_tp1_hit() =>
    if not tp1_hit and not na(tp1_price)
        hit = trade_direction == 1 ? high >= tp1_price : low <= tp1_price
        if hit
            tp1_hit := true
            if move_to_be
                pip = syminfo.mintick * 10
                sl_price := entry_price + (trade_direction * be_offset * pip)
        hit
    else
        false

check_tp2_hit() =>
    if tp1_hit and not tp2_hit and not na(tp2_price)
        hit = trade_direction == 1 ? high >= tp2_price : low <= tp2_price
        if hit
            tp2_hit := true
        hit
    else
        false

// ─── PLOTTING ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot(tp1_price, "TP1", color=#26a269, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(tp2_price, "TP2", color=#00abff, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(sl_price, "SL", color=#f23645, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(entry_price, "Entry", color=#888, style=plot.style_linebr)

// ─── USAGE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 1. Call set_trade(entry, sl, direction) when entering
// 2. Call check_tp1_hit() and check_tp2_hit() each bar
// 3. Use tp1_hit/tp2_hit to trigger partial closes

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TP/SL PRICE CALCULATOR — Quant Prime Recoil Module
// Calculate exact prices for your targets and stops.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ─── INPUTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
calc_show    = input.bool(true, "Show Calculator", group="TP/SL Calc")
entry_price  = input.price(0.0, "Entry Price", group="TP/SL Calc")
sl_price_in  = input.price(0.0, "Stop Loss Price", group="TP/SL Calc")

tp2_rr       = input.float(2.5, "TP2 R:R", step=0.1, group="Targets")
tp3_rr       = input.float(4.0, "TP3 R:R", step=0.1, group="Targets")

// ─── CALCULATIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────
is_long = trade_dir == "Long"
risk = math.abs(entry_price - sl_price_in)

tp2_pips = math.abs(tp2_price - entry_price) / pip_size
tp3_pips = math.abs(tp3_price - entry_price) / pip_size

products.preview:
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// VORTEX DIGITAL ROOT ENGINE — Quant Prime Meridian Module
// Numerological price level detection (3, 6, 9 alignment).
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ─── INPUTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
vortex_show  = input.bool(true, "Show Vortex Points", group="Vortex Engine")
check_1d     = input.bool(true, "Check Last 1 Digit", group="Vortex Engine")
check_2d     = input.bool(true, "Check Last 2 Digits (sum)", group="Vortex Engine")
check_3d     = input.bool(true, "Check Last 3 Digits (sum)", group="Vortex Engine")
mark_highs   = input.bool(true, "Mark Highs", group="Vortex Engine")
mark_lows    = input.bool(true, "Mark Lows", group="Vortex Engine")

vortex_col   = input.color(#c9a84c, "Vortex Color", group="Vortex Engine")

// Which digits to trigger on
enable_3 = input.bool(true, "3", inline="369", group="Enable Digits")
enable_6 = input.bool(true, "6", inline="369", group="Enable Digits")
enable_9 = input.bool(true, "9", inline="369", group="Enable Digits")

// ─── DIGITAL ROOT FUNCTION ────────────────────────────────────
digital_root(val) =>
    v = math.abs(math.round(val))
    while v > 9
        sum = 0
        while v > 0
            sum := sum + (v % 10)
            v := math.floor(v / 10)
        v := sum
    v

// Get last N digits of a price
get_last_digits(price, n) =>
    multiplied = math.round(price / syminfo.mintick)
    result = 0
    for i = 0 to n - 1
        result := result + math.floor((multiplied / math.pow(10, i)) % 10) * math.pow(10, i)
    result

// ─── VORTEX CHECK ─────────────────────────────────────────────
is_vortex_number(val) =>
    (enable_3 and val == 3) or (enable_6 and val == 6) or (enable_9 and val == 9)

check_vortex(price) =>
    hit = false
    if check_1d
        d1 = get_last_digits(price, 1)
        hit := hit or is_vortex_number(d1)
    if check_2d
        d2 = get_last_digits(price, 2)
        hit := hit or is_vortex_number(digital_root(d2))
    if check_3d
        d3 = get_last_digits(price, 3)
        hit := hit or is_vortex_number(digital_root(d3))
    hit

// Check highs and lows
high_vortex = mark_highs and check_vortex(high)
low_vortex = mark_lows and check_vortex(low)

// ─── PLOTTING ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
plotshape(vortex_show and high_vortex, "High Vortex", shape.circle, location.abovebar, vortex_col, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(vortex_show and low_vortex, "Low Vortex", shape.circle, location.belowbar, vortex_col, size=size.tiny)

// ─── USAGE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// high_vortex: true when high hits a 3/6/9 level
// low_vortex: true when low hits a 3/6/9 level
// Use with AMD A-line sweeps for Meridian signals

products.preview:
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CYCLE CONFLUENCE DETECTOR — Quant Prime Meridian Module
// Finds alignment across multiple cycle lengths.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ─── INPUTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
cc_show      = input.bool(true, "Show Confluence", group="Cycle Confluence")
cycle1_len   = input.int(8, "Cycle 1 Length", group="Cycle Confluence")
cycle2_len   = input.int(21, "Cycle 2 Length", group="Cycle Confluence")
cycle3_len   = input.int(55, "Cycle 3 Length", group="Cycle Confluence")
min_conf     = input.int(2, "Min Cycles Aligned", minval=2, maxval=3, group="Cycle Confluence")

conf_col     = input.color(#c9a84c, "Confluence Color", group="Cycle Confluence")

// ─── CYCLE PHASE CALCULATION ──────────────────────────────────
// Simplified cycle phase using RSI-based approach
cycle_phase(len) =>
    rsi = ta.rsi(close, len)
    phase = rsi > 70 ? "TOP" : rsi < 30 ? "BOTTOM" : rsi > 50 ? "RISING" : "FALLING"
    [phase, rsi]

[phase1, rsi1] = cycle_phase(cycle1_len)
[phase2, rsi2] = cycle_phase(cycle2_len)
[phase3, rsi3] = cycle_phase(cycle3_len)

// ─── CONFLUENCE DETECTION ─────────────────────────────────────
// Count how many cycles are at tops/bottoms
at_top = (phase1 == "TOP" ? 1 : 0) + (phase2 == "TOP" ? 1 : 0) + (phase3 == "TOP" ? 1 : 0)
at_bottom = (phase1 == "BOTTOM" ? 1 : 0) + (phase2 == "BOTTOM" ? 1 : 0) + (phase3 == "BOTTOM" ? 1 : 0)

bearish_confluence = at_top >= min_conf
bullish_confluence = at_bottom >= min_conf
confluence_score = math.max(at_top, at_bottom)

// ─── PLOTTING ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
plotshape(cc_show and bearish_confluence, "Bear Confluence", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, #f23645, size=size.small)
plotshape(cc_show and bullish_confluence, "Bull Confluence", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, #26a269, size=size.small)

// Background highlight on confluence
bgcolor(cc_show and bearish_confluence ? color.new(#f23645, 90) : cc_show and bullish_confluence ? color.new(#26a269, 90) : na)

// ─── DASHBOARD ────────────────────────────────────────────────
var table cc_tbl = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 5, bgcolor=#1a1a1a, border_width=1)
if cc_show and barstate.islast
    table.cell(cc_tbl, 0, 0, "CONFLUENCE", text_color=#c9a84c)
    table.cell(cc_tbl, 0, 1, "C1 (" + str.tostring(cycle1_len) + "):", text_color=#888)
    table.cell(cc_tbl, 1, 1, phase1, text_color=phase1=="TOP"?#f23645:phase1=="BOTTOM"?#26a269:#888)
    table.cell(cc_tbl, 0, 2, "C2 (" + str.tostring(cycle2_len) + "):", text_color=#888)
    table.cell(cc_tbl, 1, 2, phase2, text_color=phase2=="TOP"?#f23645:phase2=="BOTTOM"?#26a269:#888)
    table.cell(cc_tbl, 0, 3, "C3 (" + str.tostring(cycle3_len) + "):", text_color=#888)
    table.cell(cc_tbl, 1, 3, phase3, text_color=phase3=="TOP"?#f23645:phase3=="BOTTOM"?#26a269:#888)
    table.cell(cc_tbl, 0, 4, "Score:", text_color=#888)
    table.cell(cc_tbl, 1, 4, str.tostring(confluence_score) + "/3", text_color=#c9a84c)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// FAIR VALUE GAP DETECTOR — Quant Prime Cockpit Module
// Detects and tracks FVG imbalance zones.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ─── INPUTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fvg_show     = input.bool(true, "Show FVGs", group="FVG Detector")
fvg_max      = input.int(10, "Max FVGs to Show", minval=1, maxval=50, group="FVG Detector")
fvg_extend   = input.int(50, "Extend Bars", group="FVG Detector")
show_filled  = input.bool(false, "Show Filled FVGs", group="FVG Detector")

bull_fvg_col = input.color(color.new(#26a269, 80), "Bullish FVG", group="FVG Colors")
bear_fvg_col = input.color(color.new(#f23645, 80), "Bearish FVG", group="FVG Colors")

// ─── FVG DETECTION ────────────────────────────────────────────
// Bullish FVG: gap between candle 2 high and candle 0 low
bull_fvg = low > high[2] and close[1] > open[1]
bull_fvg_top = low
bull_fvg_bot = high[2]

// Bearish FVG: gap between candle 2 low and candle 0 high  
bear_fvg = high < low[2] and close[1] < open[1]
bear_fvg_top = low[2]
bear_fvg_bot = high

// ─── FVG TRACKING ─────────────────────────────────────────────
type FVG
    float top
    float bottom
    int start_bar
    bool is_bull
    bool is_filled
    box bx

var FVG[] fvgs = array.new<FVG>()

// Add new FVGs
if fvg_show and bull_fvg
    fvg = FVG.new(bull_fvg_top, bull_fvg_bot, bar_index, true, false, box.new(bar_index-2, bull_fvg_top, bar_index+fvg_extend, bull_fvg_bot, border_color=na, bgcolor=bull_fvg_col))
    array.push(fvgs, fvg)

if fvg_show and bear_fvg
    fvg = FVG.new(bear_fvg_top, bear_fvg_bot, bar_index, false, false, box.new(bar_index-2, bear_fvg_top, bar_index+fvg_extend, bear_fvg_bot, border_color=na, bgcolor=bear_fvg_col))
    array.push(fvgs, fvg)

// Check for fills and update boxes
if array.size(fvgs) > 0
    for i = array.size(fvgs) - 1 to 0
        fvg = array.get(fvgs, i)
        mid = (fvg.top + fvg.bottom) / 2
        
        // Check if filled (price crossed through 50%)
        filled = fvg.is_bull ? low <= mid : high >= mid
        
        if filled and not fvg.is_filled
            fvg.is_filled := true
            if not show_filled
                box.delete(fvg.bx)
                array.remove(fvgs, i)
        
        // Limit array size
        if array.size(fvgs) > fvg_max
            old = array.shift(fvgs)
            box.delete(old.bx)

// ─── COUNT ACTIVE FVGs ────────────────────────────────────────
bull_count = 0, bear_count = 0
for fvg in fvgs
    if not fvg.is_filled
        if fvg.is_bull
            bull_count += 1
        else
            bear_count += 1

// ─── USAGE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// bull_fvg / bear_fvg: true when new FVG forms
// fvgs array: all tracked FVGs with their states
// Use FVG zones as support/resistance for entries

products.preview:
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MULTI-TF REGIME AGGREGATOR — Quant Prime Cockpit Module
// Combines regime scores across 4 timeframes.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ─── INPUTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
mtf_show     = input.bool(true, "Show MTF Panel", group="MTF Regime")
tf1          = input.timeframe("5", "Timeframe 1", group="MTF Regime")
tf2          = input.timeframe("15", "Timeframe 2", group="MTF Regime")
tf3          = input.timeframe("60", "Timeframe 3", group="MTF Regime")
tf4          = input.timeframe("240", "Timeframe 4", group="MTF Regime")

// ─── REGIME CALCULATION FUNCTION ──────────────────────────────
calc_regime() =>
    atr = ta.atr(14)
    atr_sma = ta.sma(atr, 50)
    vol_ok = atr / atr_sma > 0.8 and atr / atr_sma < 1.5
    [_, _, adx] = ta.dmi(14, 14)
    score = (vol_ok ? 40 : 20) + math.min(adx, 50)
    score

// ─── MULTI-TF DATA ────────────────────────────────────────────
[score1] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf1, [calc_regime()])
[score2] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf2, [calc_regime()])
[score3] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf3, [calc_regime()])
[score4] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf4, [calc_regime()])

// ─── AGGREGATE ────────────────────────────────────────────────
avg_score = (score1 + score2 + score3 + score4) / 4
min_score = math.min(score1, math.min(score2, math.min(score3, score4)))

// Count how many TFs are favorable (score >= 55)
fav_count = (score1 >= 55 ? 1 : 0) + (score2 >= 55 ? 1 : 0) + (score3 >= 55 ? 1 : 0) + (score4 >= 55 ? 1 : 0)
all_aligned = fav_count == 4
most_aligned = fav_count >= 3

// Regime classification helper
get_regime(score) => score >= 70 ? "PRIME" : score >= 55 ? "FAV" : score >= 40 ? "MARG" : "DEG"
get_col(score) => score >= 70 ? #26a269 : score >= 55 ? #00abff : score >= 40 ? #c9a84c : #f23645

// ─── DASHBOARD ────────────────────────────────────────────────
var table mtf_tbl = table.new(position.top_right, 3, 6, bgcolor=#1a1a1a, border_width=1)
if mtf_show and barstate.islast
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 0, 0, "MTF REGIME", text_color=#c9a84c, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 1, 0, "SCORE", text_color=#888)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 2, 0, "STATE", text_color=#888)
    
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 0, 1, tf1, text_color=#fff)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 1, 1, str.tostring(math.round(score1)), text_color=#fff)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 2, 1, get_regime(score1), text_color=get_col(score1))
    
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 0, 2, tf2, text_color=#fff)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 1, 2, str.tostring(math.round(score2)), text_color=#fff)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 2, 2, get_regime(score2), text_color=get_col(score2))
    
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 0, 3, tf3, text_color=#fff)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 1, 3, str.tostring(math.round(score3)), text_color=#fff)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 2, 3, get_regime(score3), text_color=get_col(score3))
    
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 0, 4, tf4, text_color=#fff)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 1, 4, str.tostring(math.round(score4)), text_color=#fff)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 2, 4, get_regime(score4), text_color=get_col(score4))
    
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 0, 5, "ALIGNED:", text_color=#888)
    table.cell(mtf_tbl, 1, 5, str.tostring(fav_count) + "/4", text_color=all_aligned?#26a269:most_aligned?#00abff:#f23645)

// ─── USAGE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// all_aligned: true when all 4 TFs are favorable+
// most_aligned: true when 3+ TFs are favorable+
// avg_score: average regime score across TFs
